description: Academic writing methodology advisor by Paper论文智导 (paper.ac.cn): structure diagnosis, citation style guidance, and writing rhythm planning, with self-check skills for formatting and risk estimation

displayDescription.en: An academic writing methodology advisor from Paper论文智导 (paper.ac.cn): thesis outline structure diagnosis, citation standards guidance (GB/T 7714, APA, MLA, etc.), and writing rhythm planning — with linked skills for reference formatting, similarity risk, and AI-trace self-checks. Provides methodology guidance only; it never writes content on your behalf.
